title: qldpc-verified-board: quantum LDPC codes with checkable distance evidence
description: Quantum LDPC codes found by structured concept evolution (SCE, arXiv:2606.24808) and entries of the Unitary Foundation qLDPC challenge re-measured with the same search, for encoding rates k/n above 0.1. Each code is given by its parity-check matrices H_X and H_Z (MatrixMarket format), the lightest logical operators found, and, where available, the records of an exact distance certificate. Every distance statement says what is proven: exact distance, search upper bound or lower bound. The scripts tools/verify.py and tools/check_all.py check the matrices and the operators.
